decision.observed_event: You declare: "I walk up to the card table, grab the edge, and heave it over, coins and all. [Athletics: I rolled 11 + 7 = 18]"

appraisal.label: concern
appraisal.cause: A barbarian grabs the table to flip it.

improv_read.player_bid: Brakka grabs the card table to heave it over.
improv_read.connection: Greed and fear pull the gang toward the money; Uktarl wants control without risk.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit shows priorities under pressure without narrating an outcome the table did not resolve.

public_brief.objective: Protect the money and stop the violence without risking himself.
public_brief.tactic: Save the deck, let his men cover the coins, and demand the dwarf state his business.
public_brief.visible_cue: Three of them grab for coins, ring, and deck; the fourth only watches.
public_brief.player_opening: He can let go, finish the heave, or say what he wants.
public_brief.reply_to: grab the edge, and heave it over, coins and all
public_brief.kit_focus: Give each of the four their own instinct in the same instant, and leave the table's fate to the player.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, tight, dry humor: chaos with each man showing his greed

player_mood.cue: heave it over, coins and all

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The moment your hands close on the table edge, three of them move at once: the door-side player throws himself across his stack, the fresco-side player grabs for the silver ring, and the dealer snatches the deck to his chest. Only the fourth player does not reach for anything. It watches you.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Have you lost your wits, mountain? That is the house's gold you are tipping into the dust, and the house remembers who spills it. Let go of my table, and tell me what you want, before my brothers decide for you. Well?
